label: Teltonika RUT976 (RedCap 5G)
description: 5G RedCap router: 1x 100 Mbps WAN, 3x 100 Mbps LAN, Wi-Fi.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUT976 datasheet: **1x WAN port 10/100 Mbps** and **3x LAN ports, 10/100 Mbps**, plus Wi-Fi and a 5G RedCap modem. **A 5G router whose every copper port is fast Ethernet** - RedCap itself is a reduced-capability 5G profile, so the port ceiling here is not an oversight but it is still the number that decides whether an office can use it.
